decisions.reason: As a height-adjustable desk system close to the firm's core furniture business and a still-relevant office segment, it is worth keeping unless sales have clearly disappointed.
A chair family is a standard, scalable category for an established furniture maker, so the firm would likely continue it if it has achieved even moderate market acceptance.
Floor cushions made from carpets look like a peripheral experiment, and after several years the option value is likely exhausted if demand has not become clearly attractive.
The upholstered sofa appears to be a deliberate designer-led extension into soft seating, and the firm would likely keep it a bit longer if it supports a broader interior offering.
A high standing table is easier to prune from a broad portfolio once learning has occurred, especially if it has not become a meaningful complement to the firm's main lines.
The rug collection is relatively peripheral to core furniture manufacturing, so management would likely reallocate resources if it has not shown strong pull by 2022.
